tools.name: search_local_events
tools.description: Find upcoming events (concerts, comedy, theatre, sports, family shows, festivals) near a US ZIP code, a city or coordinates, filtered by dates, categories (Music, Sports, Arts & Theatre, Film, Miscellaneous, or genres such as Jazz or Comedy), keywords, artist, venue and maximum price. Returns events

tools.name: get_event_details
tools.description: Full details for one event by event_id (from any other tool): venue, performers, price range if published, ticket link, source records, when AgentStructure first saw it, and its history of detected changes. Refreshes from Ticketmaster when stored data is older than 6 hours.

tools.name: track_event_interests
tools.description: Save a persistent watchlist: a place (US ZIP code, city or coordinates, plus radius_km) and/or followed artists or teams, with optional categories, keywords, venues, maximum price and how many days ahead. AgentStructure then checks on a schedule and records newly observed matching events and changes

tools.name: list_local_event_alerts
tools.description: Return new alerts for this user: newly observed events matching a watchlist or a followed artist, and changes (cancelled, postponed, rescheduled, date, time, venue or price changes, sale start) to matching or saved events. Returned alerts are marked as read. Set refresh true to run a small check rig

tools.name: get_weekend_recommendations
tools.description: Rank events for the coming weekend (Friday to Sunday local dates) near a saved or given location, using the user's saved interests, followed artists, budget, preferred days and times, and past feedback. Each result says why it was recommended, using only what actually matched. Pass busy intervals fr

tools.name: get_event_changes
tools.description: Detected changes with previous and current values, for one event_id or for all events the user saved, is going to or marked interested. EVENT_MISSING_FROM_SOURCE is low confidence and does not mean cancelled.

tools.name: manage_event_watchlist
tools.description: List, pause, resume, update or delete the user's watchlists by name. Also shows plan limits.

tools.name: save_event_feedback
tools.description: Record the user's reaction to an event: interested, not_interested (never recommend again), going, saved (alerts on changes), more_like_this or less_like_this (adjusts genre weighting). Only call when the user says so; never infer it.

tools.name: get_followed_artists
tools.description: List the performers and teams this user follows.

tools.name: manage_event_profile
tools.description: View or change the user's event preferences and privacy: budget, preferred days and times, time zone, interests (artist, team, genre, category, venue, keyword), saved locations (city precision; trips with valid_from/valid_until never replace home), clear personalization, or delete the account and al

tools.name: manage_alert_delivery
tools.description: Choose where alerts go besides this chat: add_email sends a confirmation link to the address (alerts start only after the user confirms), add_phone returns a private subscribe link for the free ntfy phone app, add_sms (paid plans, U.S. numbers) texts a 6-digit code to phone; pass consent: true only

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "manage_alert_delivery" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_local_events, get_event_details, manage_alert_delivery · Private data: get_event_details, track_event_interests, save_event_feedback, manage_alert_delivery · Public sink: get_weekend_recommendations · Destructive: list_local_event_alerts, manage_event_watchlist, manage_event_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_local_events, get_event_details, manage_alert_delivery · Private data: get_event_details, track_event_interests, save_event_feedback, manage_alert_delivery · Public sink: get_weekend_recommendations · Destructive: list_local_event_alerts, manage_event_watchlist, manage_event_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
